== Summary ==
Uncut [[Enhanced Cloud City]] sheet, the consolation winner's prize at the [[2022 World Championship]], photographed with four deck boxes.

The printer line on the sheet reads "Star Wars Enhanced Cloud City Imperial", "Uncut Sheet", and "Not for sale". The prize list in the same thread names the consolation winner's prize as an uncut Enhanced Cloud City Dark Side sheet.

* '''Event:''' [[2022 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 4 October 2022

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=81324 PRIZE SUPPORT: 2022 World Championship], post 1389573, by Jnapolit31, 4 October 2022. Original attachment name: IMG_5457.jpeg (3024×3529); forum attachment id 17784. The prize was named in the same thread on 9 August 2022.
* '''Posted by:''' Jnapolit31
